_doc: The vertical Shorts (remotion/src/Shorts.tsx, one composition per entry: Short-<id>), 1080x1920, after Distillation (Allegedly): the 'Effective immediately' lower third as the title above (brief), the whole picture below it, uncropped, 950 px wide, clear of the platforms' right-hand buttons, and the lyrics under it. Everything sits in y 140-1400. from/to: frames of the main edit, on shot boundaries; the music starts on the first frame, with short fades at both ends added when encoding.

chorus.note: The brief's Short: E08 (the vote, one hand per beat) through chorus 1, the market drop on the screen, to the end of the chorus. 43.0 s.

bridge.note: The night phones: 'would be honored', the missed calls, SENIOR LEVELS on the desk phone and the tags. 34.1 s.

reinstated.note: The final chorus: the jacket back on the hook, the vote with the +31.5% chart, the probe and its purchase order, couples counseling and the Chief Compliance Officer sign. 37.0 s.

plaque.note: The outro: the plaque comes down and goes back up, 'eleven days for you, and two for it', ending before the end credits. 17.8 s.
